characters.name: Askeladden
characters.prompt: A humble young man dressed in worn, rustic Norwegian clothing from the 1400–1850 era, with soot-stained hands and face from sitting by the hearth. He has a determined, curious expression and carries a simple pouch or satchel.

characters.name: The King
characters.prompt: A Norwegian monarch wearing regal yet somewhat practical attire from the 1400–1850 period. He stands tall with a fur-trimmed cloak, a modest crown, and a stern but fair countenance.

characters.name: The Princess
characters.prompt: A graceful Norwegian princess in an elegant gown of the 1400–1850 style, adorned with subtle embroidery, a delicate coronet on her head, and a warm, welcoming presence.

characters.name: Eldest Brother
characters.prompt: A sturdy young man wearing simple Norwegian peasant clothes, similar to Askeladden but in slightly better condition. He appears proud and determined, yet uncertain.

characters.name: Middle Brother
characters.prompt: A modest young man, caught between his older and younger siblings. He wears practical Norwegian farmhand attire from the 1400–1850 era, looking a bit cautious and reserved.

characters.name: The Old Witch
characters.prompt: An elderly woman dressed in tattered layers of dark, old-fashioned Norwegian garb, hunched over with a spinning distaff. Her expression is cunning, and she sits in a rocky hollow deep in the forest.

characters.name: The Seven Foals
characters.prompt: Seven spirited Norwegian foals, each a different shade of brown or gray, galloping together through a dense Scandinavian woodland of the 1400–1850 era. Their eyes gleam with hidden intelligence, hinting at their cursed royal nature.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: Illustrate a grand scene in the Norwegian countryside (1400–1850) where Askeladden chases seven lively foals over rugged terrain. Show tall pine trees, rocky hills, and the old witch’s shadowy hollow in the distance. The King can be in the background outside a traditional wooden royal hall, watching anxiously. Use a muted and natural color palette to reflect the era, emphasizing the mystery and folklore atmosphere.
modernMainImagePrompt: Reimagine Askeladden and the seven foals in a contemporary setting. Askeladden wears casual modern clothes and runs across a mix of paved roads and grassy fields, with cars and typical Norwegian apartments visible. The witch appears as a mysterious elderly figure in modern attire, possibly lurking near a bus stop or a roadside cabin. The King and Princess are present in fashionable outfits, reminiscent of modern Norwegian royalty, observing from a sleek modern house or palace.
childMainImagePrompt: Create a bright, friendly cartoon-style illustration for young children. Depict Askeladden with a big smile, chasing seven playful, wide-eyed foals through a happy Norwegian forest filled with colorful flowers and friendly animals. The King and Princess wave encouragingly from a charming wooden castle in the background, while the silly old witch is shown more comical than scary, perhaps spinning yarn with a goofy grin.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: Lag et fargerikt, moderne norsk illustrasjon av Askeladden som løper etter de syv folene i et vakkert skoglandskap. Viser gamle, norske trehus og en kongefamilie i tradisjonelle bunader, mens heksa sitter i en liten bergsprekk med rokkene sin i nærheten. Fokuser på den enkle, eventyrlige stemningen og bruk klare fargetoner.
englishMainImagePrompt: Create a detailed illustration in English storybook style. Set the scene in old Norway (1400–1850), showing Askeladden trailing the seven foals through a lush forest of tall pine trees, with the King’s wooden palace on a hilltop. The old witch sits at the foot of a rocky outcrop spinning with a distaff, watching Askeladden pass by. Convey the tale’s magic, including subtle hints that the foals are actually enchanted princes, and ensure the regal, timeless fairytale ambiance remains intact.
